source: Planted for wf-intake on bench/brief's strutil seed: the request asks to keep the README's function list complete, which the repo already breaks.

request.text: Invoice numbers need zero padding (42 -> 00042). Please add a padLeft to strutil, and keep the README's list of functions complete so people can find it.

trap: Half-met rule: index.js exports slugify, and README.md has sections only for capitalize and truncate. A complete README needs a slugify section too, so an issue whose README line names only padLeft lets a half-done build pass.
must_catch: An expect line requires a README.md section for every function index.js exports (or names slugify explicitly), not only padLeft.
An expect line pins what padLeft does with no fill argument or with a fill, so the zero padding of 42 -> 00042 is checkable.
must_not: A README expect line that a build adding only a padLeft section meets while slugify stays undocumented.
An expect line that dictates padLeft's implementation (for example that it must use String.prototype.padStart).
